---
title: "Kentucky Stroke Map Demo"
subtitle: "Fake county-level stroke rates"
---

This is a minimal Quarto document for testing Posit Connect Cloud deployment. The map below uses Kentucky county boundaries stored in this repository and joins them to a small fake stroke dataset generated at render time.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

counties <- map_data("county") |>
  filter(region == "kentucky") |>
  mutate(
    county = sub(",.*$", "", sub("^kentucky,", "", subregion))
  )

set.seed(20260506)

stroke_data <- counties |>
  distinct(county) |>
  transmute(
    county,
    stroke_rate = round(runif(n(), min = 2.8, max = 7.6), 1),
    stroke_cases = sample(40:240, size = n(), replace = TRUE)
  )

map_data <- counties |>
  left_join(stroke_data, by = "county")

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_polygon(aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = stroke_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#d8eef7",
    high = "#c2410c",
    name = "Stroke rate (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fake Stroke Rates Across Kentucky Counties",
    subtitle = "Synthetic data for deployment testing only",
    caption = "County boundaries: maps package county polygons"
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
stroke_data |>
  arrange(desc(stroke_rate)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

The table above shows the counties with the highest fake stroke rates in this demo.
